prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a side impact at intersection in Pearland, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1386; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thanks for taking the time to speak with me today. This is a recorded statement regarding the collision at the intersection in Pearland, Texas. Do you understand that this call is being recorded?

A: Yes, I understand.

Q: Can you describe where you were coming from and where you were headed when the accident happened?

A: I was driving home from work. I was going straight through the intersection on a green light.

Q: What was the traffic like as you approached?

A: It was fairly light. There was one car in front of me that had already cleared the intersection.

Q: Did you see the other vehicle before the impact?

A: Not really. It came from my right side, and I didn't see it until it was almost on top of me. I braked, but there wasn't enough time.

Q: Which part of your vehicle was struck?

A: The driver's side door, right behind my mirror.

Q: Were you injured?

A: Yes, I have some neck pain and stiffness. It started a few hours after the accident and has been getting a little worse each day.

Q: Have you seen a doctor or other medical provider since the collision?

A: Yes, I went to urgent care that evening. They diagnosed me with a neck strain and gave me muscle relaxers and a referral to a physical therapist.

Q: Have you had any prior neck problems or injuries?

A: No, nothing serious. I had some minor stiffness once after sleeping wrong, but nothing that required treatment.

Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add about the accident?

A: Just that I'm trying to get back to normal. Missing work has been hard, and I'd appreciate it if this gets resolved quickly.

Q: Thank you. That concludes the statement.
